description: An 8 by 8 matrix patch bay: each button stands for one port somewhere in the patch, and pressing two of them creates or removes a cable between those ports, with eight scenes of stored cabling.

params.text: Press it once to select the port assigned to it, which blinks white, then press a second button to create a cable between the two ports or to remove the one already there; pressing it again cancels.
Selects that scene, removing the cables stored in the scene being left and creating those stored in this one; its lamp is bright while it is the active scene and dim while it holds cables but is not

notes: a button does nothing until a port is assigned to it: right-click it, choose Learn under Module port, then click a port in the patch; or drag a cable from a port and drop it on the button
this module has no jacks of its own; it only makes and breaks cables between ports on other modules, and is never in the signal path itself
only an output can be joined to an input, so pressing two buttons of the same direction does nothing
a scene stores only cables whose two ends are both assigned to buttons on this module; any other cable in the patch is left alone by a scene change
all eight scenes share one set of port assignments: a scene holds the cabling, not which port each button stands for
left-drag one button onto another to create or remove the cable between them, and shift-drag to move a button's port, label, colour and cabling onto another
drag one scene button onto another to copy the first scene's cabling over the second
press Space while the pointer is over the module to hide the patch's cables and draw a line from each button to the port assigned to it; press it again to go back
a button's lamp is red for an output and blue for an input, dim with no cable and bright with one; white blinking awaits a second press, grey blinking is a port learn, pale blue a MIDI learn
while a button is waiting for its second press, every button already cabled to it blinks slowly in its own colour
menu: Button mode: Toggle, Momentary — Toggle keeps the first button selected until a second is pressed; Momentary drops the selection when the first is released
Cross-instance patching — on to let a button here pair with a button on another SPLICE-KIT; cables made that way are ordinary patch cables and belong to no scene
Scene link master — picks another SPLICE-KIT whose scene selection this one follows, or None; while a master is set this module's own scene buttons do nothing
Show overlay messages — the short on-screen notice naming the two ports each time a cable is created or removed
Visualize — turns on the view that hides the patch's cables and draws a line from each button to its port, as pressing Space does
Randomize — clears every port assignment and label, then gives as many buttons as it can a different random port from anywhere in the patch
Sequential port learn — assigns each port you click to the next button in turn, from the one you started at through to button 64
Sequential MIDI learn — maps each MIDI message received to the next button in turn; the scene buttons are left out of it
MIDI Input and MIDI Output — the device button presses are read from, and the device the lamp states are sent back to
MIDI Preset — shapes the lamp feedback for one controller: No preset, the Launchpad, APC Mini and Push 2 entries, or Generic (Note On); an entry marked untested is unconfirmed on the hardware
Apply input mappings from preset — clears the MIDI input assignments and maps every button to the note or control change the chosen preset lays out
Load preset from file... and Save preset to file... — read a feedback preset from a JSON file, or write the active one out as one
MIDI scene-copy gesture — off to start with; on, holding one mapped scene button and pressing a second copies the first scene's cabling over the second, which cannot be undone
Module port: Learn, Clear, Start sequential learn..., in a matrix button's own right-click menu — sets which port that button stands for, or takes it away along with its cables in every scene
Color: Auto, Red, Blue, Orange, Green, in a matrix button's own right-click menu — overrides the lamp colour, which is otherwise red for an output and blue for an input
Custom label..., in a matrix button's own right-click menu — the name shown in that button's tooltip and in the overlay messages in place of the port's own
Remove cable and Remove all cables, in a matrix button's own right-click menu — take away one, or every one, of that button's cables in the current scene
MIDI: Learn, Clear, Start sequential learn..., in a matrix button's own right-click menu — maps a control change or note to that button, or takes the mapping away
Clear, Copy, Paste, Learn MIDI, Clear MIDI, in a scene button's own right-click menu — empty that scene, move its cabling through the clipboard, or map it to MIDI
Randomize: Sparse, Full, in the active scene button's own menu — Sparse pairs each assigned output with a different assigned input; Full reuses the shorter side so every port gets a cable
